# CalMatters

> > CalMatters is a nonprofit, nonpartisan journalism organization dedicated to covering California politics and policy with in-depth reporting and analysis.

CalMatters is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit newsroom that provides independent journalism focused on California state politics, governance, and policy issues. The organization relies on reader support and philanthropic funding to sustain its mission of covering issues that matter to Californians.

## Key Topics

- CalMatters
- nonprofit journalism
- California politics
- 501(c)(3) organization
